# The Santa Barbara Independent

> Santa Barbara's leading independent news source covering local news, arts, entertainment, community events, and investigative journalism.

The Santa Barbara Independent is a community-focused news organization serving Santa Barbara County with comprehensive coverage of local events, breaking news, cultural features, and in-depth investigations. The site provides essential community services including event calendars, obituaries, and reader engagement channels.

## Key Topics

- Santa Barbara news
- Local community events
- Arts and entertainment
- Food and drink
- Santa Barbara County
- Investigative journalism
- Mental health policy
- Crime and public safety
- Business news
- Event calendar
- Reader submissions
- Editorial coverage
- Goleta
- Community engagement

## News & Coverage

- [The Santa Barbara Independent](https://www.independent.com): Homepage: Leading source for Santa Barbara news, arts, entertainment
- [Cover Stories](https://www.independent.com/cover-stories): Archive of cover stories and major news features
- [With New Mental Health Beds on Horizon in North County, Santa Barbara DA Takes Exception to State's Diversion Law](https://www.independent.com/2026/03/17/with-new-mental-health-beds-on-horizon-in-north-county-santa-barbara-da-takes-exception-to-states-diversion-law): Investigation into DA's stance on mental health diversion law
- [Suspected DUI Stop Near Summerland Uncovers Large Fentanyl Cache](https://www.independent.com/2026/03/18/suspected-dui-stop-near-summerland-uncovers-large-fentanyl-cache): Crime report on fentanyl seizure near Summerland

## Events & Community Calendar

- [Events Archive](https://www.independent.com/events): Events calendar and archive for Santa Barbara community
- [Create Event](https://www.independent.com/create-event): Event submission form for Santa Barbara community events
- [Here Comes Santa Barbara Coffee Week!](https://www.independent.com/2026/03/18/here-comes-santa-barbara-coffee-week): Coverage of Santa Barbara's first Coffee Week celebration

## Business & Local Features

- [What's the Future of Frinj Coffee?](https://www.independent.com/2026/03/18/whats-the-future-of-frinj-coffee): Business news on Frinj Coffee's future after founders' deaths

## Community Services

- [Obituaries](https://www.independent.com/obits): Obituaries, death notices, and in memoriam listings
- [About Us](https://www.independent.com/about-us): Company overview and editorial team information
- [Contact Us](https://www.independent.com/contact-us): Contact information and submission channels
